description: This file defines the DynamoDBGrainStorage class, which implements Orleans grain storage using DynamoDB. It includes methods for initializing the storage, reading, writing, and clearing grain state, and handles DynamoDB interactions and serialization.

classes.name: DynamoDBGrainStorage
classes.description: Implements Orleans grain storage using DynamoDB, providing methods for initialization, reading, writing, and clearing grain state, with detailed logging and DynamoDB interaction.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the storage provider to the silo lifecycle events.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the DynamoDB table and storage settings asynchronously.

methods.name: WriteStateInternal
methods.description: Internal method to handle the actual writing of grain state, including ETag management.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears or deletes grain state in DynamoDB based on configuration.

methods.name: ConvertFromStorageFormat
methods.description: Deserializes stored byte array into grain state object.

methods.name: ConvertToStorageFormat
methods.description: Serializes grain state object into byte array for storage.

methods.name: ResetGrainState
methods.description: Resets grain state to default values.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of grain state using the activator provider.
